story:
Royal Roofing Systems is a locally owned and operated company working out of Edwardsville, Pennsylvania, with fifteen years in the roofing industry. We install and repair flat and pitched roofs on homes and businesses across Northeastern Pennsylvania — asphalt shingle, copper, slate, metal, TPO and EPDM — and we handle the rest of the exterior too: siding, seamless gutters, and custom decks.

One thing separates us from most of the companies quoting against us, and it is the first thing we tell people: when you call us about your roof, we are the roofers. We do not subcontract out. That matters more than it sounds like it should. The most common complaint homeowners have about roofing is that the person who walked the property and wrote the estimate is nowhere to be found on installation day, and the crew that shows up has no stake in the promises that were made. Our crews are our own, our materials are the materials on your estimate, and the workmanship warranty is ours to honor.

We work with homeowners, property managers, realtors and commercial building owners, including crews that specialize in historic sites — Northeastern Pennsylvania has a lot of pre-war housing wearing original slate, and we have installed hundreds of slate roofs in this area. When a storm rolls through, we are the local option: we were here before it and we will be here after it, and we work directly with your insurance adjuster so the claim reflects the damage we actually documented. Every roof we install carries a lifetime manufacturer warranty, a 10-year workmanship warranty, and a 15-year no-leak warranty. If there is a problem, you know where to find us.
